name: app.fluxygram/mcp
title: Fluxygram
description: Animated, step-by-step diagrams: learn the format, validate a diagram and get a link to watch it.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: How to write a Fluxygram diagram: the seven diagram types and when to use each, nodes, edges, steps with captions, motion, live status (tracker mode), icons and the storytelling rules. Call it before writing your first diagram.

tools.name: get_example
tools.description: Returns a complete example diagram to learn from or adapt. Without a name, lists the available examples (recipes, software architecture, OAuth login, order process, timelines, live order trackers and more).

name.description: Example name from the list, for example "sequence" or "tracker". Omit to list them.

lang.description: Language of the labels. Default en.

tools.name: validate_diagram
tools.description: Checks a Fluxygram diagram with the same validator the viewer uses. Returns "valid" with a short summary, or every problem with its path so you can fix it. Always validate before sharing.

diagram.description: The diagram: the JSON object or its text.

lang.description: Language of the error messages. Default en.

tools.name: share_link
tools.description: Validates the diagram and returns links on fluxygram.app to watch it animated, open it in the editor or present it full screen. The diagram travels inside the link (compressed); nothing is uploaded or stored. Give the view link to the user.

diagram.description: The diagram: the JSON object or its text.
